tools.name: kr_holidays
tools.description: List South Korean public holidays (공휴일) for a year or a date range, with Korean names. Holiday data covers 2024-2027 (source: KASI; updated 2026-11-12). It includes substitute holidays and election days, and the 2026 additions Labor Day (May 1) and Constitution Day (Jul 17).

tools.name: kr_business_day
tools.description: Check whether a date is a business day in South Korea (not a weekend and not a public holiday), and give the previous and next business days. tools.name: kr_add_business_days
tools.description: Move forward (or back, with negative days) a number of South Korean business days from a start date, skipping weekends and public holidays. The start date itself is not counted. tools.name: kr_count_business_days
tools.description: Count South Korean business days between two dates (both ends included by default). Also returns weekend and weekday-holiday counts. tools.name: kr_amount_to_korean
tools.description: Write a won amount in Korean words exactly: reading form ("백이십삼만 사천오백육십칠 원", spaced every 만 per Korean orthography), contract/receipt form ("일금 일백이십삼만사천오백육십칠원정"), and mixed form ("123만 4,567원"). Whole numbers below 10^20.

tools.name: kr_korean_to_amount
tools.description: Read a Korean money expression as an exact number: "1억 2천만 원", "삼백오십만원", "일금 일백만원정", "2.5억", "12만3천". Returns digits and comma form.

tools.name: kr_business_number_check
tools.description: Validate the format and check digit of South Korean business registration numbers (사업자등록번호, 10 digits, NTS weights 1,3,7,1,3,7,1,3,5) and format them as 123-45-67890. This is an offline checksum test only: it does not tell whether the business is open or closed.

tools.name: kr_age
tools.description: Compute international age (만 나이, the legal standard in Korea since June 2023) and year age (연 나이, used by the Youth Protection Act and military service) on a reference date. tools.name: kr_phone_format
tools.description: Normalize South Korean phone numbers (mobile 010, Seoul 02, regional 031-064, 070, 050x safe numbers, 15xx/16xx/18xx company numbers) to one style. Restores a leading 0 dropped by Excel, converts +82, keeps extensions. Unknown shapes return null.

tools.name: kr_address_split
tools.description: Split South Korean addresses into province/city (시도, normalized to the official name such as 서울특별시), district (시군구, including 일반구 like 수원시 영통구), base address (road name + building number) and detail (unit). Handles leading postal codes and addresses written without spaces. Rule-based; does not look

tools.name: kr_name_split
tools.description: Split Korean full names into family name and given name, recognizing two-character surnames (남궁, 황보, 제갈, 선우 …). Flags names that are ambiguous from the characters alone (선우진 = 선 + 우진 or 선우 + 진). Latin-script names use the last word as family name.

tools.name: kr_mask_pii
tools.description: Mask Korean personal data before you store, log or share it. Text mode finds and masks resident registration numbers (900101-1******), phone numbers (010-****-5678), emails (ab****@x.com) and 16-digit card numbers inside free text. tools.name: kr_text_count
tools.description: Count Korean text exactly: characters with and without spaces (as Korean job sites count 자기소개서), lines, words, UTF-8 bytes, NEIS school-record bytes (Hangul 3, ASCII 1), and SMS/LMS bytes with the message type. Models see tokens, not characters, so use this instead of estimating length.

tools.name: kr_relative_date
